name: DogmaSystems Booking for MyRent
author: dogmasystems

sections.description:
This plugin allows customers to book vehicles for short-term rentals directly from your website or app. It provides a user-friendly interface to select dates, times, pickup and drop-off locations, and view real-time availability and pricing. Designed for fast and intuitive bookings, it streamlines the rental process and integrates seamlessly with your MyRent system.

DogmaSystems script Integration

= Fetching booking for short term booking =
1.File Name: dogmasystems-booking-for-myrent.php
2.Description: Fetching booking for short term booking.

How to Test the Functionality

This plugin is an Elementor-compatible widget that integrates our short-term car rental booking system (dogmasystems-booking-for-myrent) into any WordPress website.

     Steps to Test:
         i) Install and activate the plugin.
         ii) Open any page using the Elementor Page Builder.
         iii) In the Elementor widget panel, search for: “DogmaSystems Booking”.
         iv) Drag the widget onto the page.

         #Configure the following two fields:

               i) Booking URL: (Demo value: https://demobookingen.myrent.it)
               ii) Language: (Demo value: en)

For security reasons, the booking form will only display if the website domain where the page is published has been whitelisted in our system.

Save the Elementor page. View the page on the frontend.

Support

For support or additional information, visit the plugin’s website at https://dogmasystems.com/myrent-booking.

Contributors

– dogmasystems
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory or the official website.
  2. Upload dogmasystems-booking-for-myrent.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP or the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Follow the setup instructions in the plugin as per the instruction.
sections.faq:
What features does this plugin offer?

The plugin provides features for short term car rental booking, short-term rental management and customizable email notifications.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest version of WordPress?

Yes, it has been tested with WordPress 6.0 and is compatible with PHP 7.4 and later.

Can I customize the booking forms?

Yes, the plugin allows for customizable booking forms to meet your business needs.
